name: Pointer-based evidence and derived-artifact exclusion from completion gate
goal: Reduce SYNTH's content redundancy and the commit-then-complete friction by (1) making evidence pointer-based: event-log/evidence records reference external artifacts by git SHA / content hash / URL instead of embedding content copies or full git diffs; completion records 'gitHead' as the realized-state pointer; (2) excluding derived/generated paths (proof/, dist/, *.integrity.json, canonical-state.json) from the DirtyWorkingTreeBlocksCompletion gate so only uncommitted IN-SCOPE SOURCE blocks completion; (3) keeping the event log as the authoritative provenance ledger while git remains the content store. Scope: locate the completion dirty-tree enforcement (cmdExpeditionComplete / CompleteExpedition capability) and the evidence-attach path; add a derived-path allowlist; record gitHead on EXPEDITION_COMPLETED. Preserve replay independence by keeping event-log.jsonl as the durable core. Add tests. Consider a short ADR noting the provenance-vs-content split.
